remarks: Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this beautiful 1 bedroom 1.5 bathroom ranch style unit in desirable complex perfectly located to just about everything this city has to offer. Enjoy the open floor plan featuring a beautiful kitchen with custom cabinetry, granite countertops and stainless steel appliances that opens up to the dining room/living room. Walk out to your patio overlooking the expansive perfectly maintained lawn. Tons of closet/storage, washer/dryer in unit , hardwood floors throughout, central AC and plenty of guest parking with reserved spaces are just a few of the perks. Enjoy your spacious master bedroom with beautiful full bathroom. Great commuting location with quick access to I95, Merritt Parkway and Metro North. (Brand new hot water heater and washer/dryer)
